expansion: B lymphocyte (B for bursa of Fabricius, where first identified in birds)

expansion: clustered regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats
description: Bacterial immune system that stores snippets of viral DNA as spacers and uses them to cut matching viruses.

Lymphocyte whose receptor recognizes peptide fragments presented on MHC molecules.
